contexts.text: In this chapter () the subject of initiation or betrothal is treated of.

The conjunction of good and truth is the heavenly marriage itself, but initiation is the betrothal or state preceding the marriage. But it is the state preceding the betrothal that is here described. In this state, as it is in the power of a girl to be betrothed, and afterwards as a wife to be conjoined with a husband, so it is in the power of the affection of truth to be initiated to Divine truth, and so to be conjoined with Divine good.
The initiation and conjunction of truth with good is as when a maiden is betrothed and afterwards coupled to a husband, namely, that she is to be instructed about everything before she gives consent.

The things which in the literal sense of this chapter treat of the betrothal and marriage of Rebekah with Isaac, in the inward sense treat of the initiation and conjunction of good and truth, for the initiation and conjunction of truth and good are spiritual betrothal and spiritual marriage.

In ancient times such things were given to a maiden when she was betrothed, and this on account of the representation and signification that a betrothed maiden relates to the truth of the Church which is to be conjoined with good. Illustrated.
To lie with her and compress her () = to be conjoined, but not in the lawful manner which is effected through betrothal.
To love and to betroth the daughter of a strange god () = to conjoin himself with falsity.

A ring () = what is confirmative of power in the house... as is evident from the rituals which have come to us from ancient times, as from the rituals of betrothals, of couplings, and of inaugurations, in which rings are placed upon the hand.
That he betroth her not () = that it is not able to be conjoined... To be betrothed = to be conjoined, for they who are betrothed are conjoined.

To be betrothed in the inward sense properly signifies the agreement of dispositions or of minds which precedes the conjunction of marriage; and since in the Spiritual World agreement conjoins and disagreement disjoins, by being betrothed is here signified to be conjoined.
If he betroth her to his son () = if it agrees with derived truth so that it can be conjoined with it. To betroth = to be conjoined.
When a man shall persuade a maiden who is not betrothed () = good not conjoined with truth... To be betrothed = conjunction.

Betrothals before marriages have come into use from ancient times, and represented the first conjunction, which is that of the inward man without the outward; and then the marriages themselves represented the second conjunction, which is that of the inward man with the outward.
Betrothal in the Word = the conjunction of truth and good in the inward man. Illustrated.
The love of betrothals () = the affection of spiritual life which is from truths of faith and good of love.
To betroth in mercy and in compassions () = from love towards those who are in good, and in love towards those who are in truths.
From these things it is evident that betrothal is the conjunction of good and truth with man by the Lord.
To betroth the daughter of a strange god () = to be conjoined with the evil of falsity.
To betroth in judgment () = to conjoin through Divine truth, thus through faith and a life of faith.
Betrothals and marriages among the inhabitants of that sixth Earth, Described.
How love or the will betroths to itself wisdom or the understanding...
By prepared () is signified dressed for betrothal, and the Church is no otherwise furnished for betrothal and afterwards for conjunction or marriage than through the Word...
These are the words of betrothal to the spiritual marriage...
With us [in Heaven] a priest administers betrothals, and hears, receives, confirms, and consecrates consent. TCR 748:end.
That there exists such a marriage love... may be still better known from the time of betrothal, while it is protracted and progresses to the nuptials.
On betrothals and nuptials. General article.
Consent is to be established through solemn betrothal. General article.
The causes of betrothals enumerated.
The state of betrothal may be likened to the state of spring before the summer; and the inward pleasantnesses of that state to the blossoming of trees before the fruitage.

Since the initiations and progressions of marriage love proceed in order on account of the influx of them into effective love, which begins from the nuptials, therefore in the Heavens also there are betrothals.

Through betrothal, each party is prepared for marriage love. General article. That the mind or spirit of the one is prepared through betrothal for union with the mind or spirit of the other, or what is the same, the love of the one with the love of the other, is evident from the arguments advanced in the foregoing article.
Through betrothal, the mind of the one is conjoined with the mind of the other, so that a marriage of the spirit may take place before the marriage of the body.
With these the state of betrothal serves scarcely any other purpose than to fill their concupiscences with lasciviousness, and thereby to contaminate the marriage principle of love.
Within the time of betrothal it is not allowable to be conjoined corporeally. General article.
Events of various kinds take place in consequence of hasty conjunctions, also from the too great protraction, or too great hurrying of the time of betrothals.
[On the state of betrothal.]
